source.description:
The source of the current value that is applied to the device.
 * `default` - Current value comes from the schema default.
 * `configured` - Current value comes from configuredValue.

isEditable.description: Whether or not the value is editable on this source (always `false` for `default`).

reason.description: The reason value is not editable on this source (always `FACTORY_DEFAULT` for `default`).

isEditable.description: Whether or not the value is editable on this source.

reason.description:
The reason the value is not editable on this source.
 * `NOT_AUTHORIZED` - User is not authorized to edit any values.
 * `CONFIG_MANAGED_BY_DIFFERENT_AUTHORITY` - The configuration is managed by a different authority. For example `CUCM`.

valueSpace.description: [JSON Schema](http://json-schema.org/) describing the data format of the configuration as specified by the device.
